note: What Serve already does: one plain sentence each (says), a few short requests it already answers (asks), the part of the app it is (area) and the aspects of a request it covers. An idea about the same area and aspect this close to a feature (DRAMA cosine 0.85 or more to its sentence or one of its requests) is answered with how to use it, not turned into a proposal. Reviewed like code: agent/data/ is runtime state only.
